rules_subtitle: Please read the platform rules carefully before using the platform.
accept_rules: I have read and fully accept the platform rules.
about_platform_text1: Investment Pool is a decentralized investment platform operating on the BNB Smart Chain blockchain.
about_platform_text2: The platform uses a smart contract to automatically execute all investment operations without the involvement of third parties.
about_principle1: All investments are managed by the smart contract.
about_principle2: All transactions are recorded on the blockchain and are fully transparent.
about_principle3: Rewards are calculated automatically according to the selected investment period.
about_principle4: Users have full control over their funds through their own cryptocurrency wallet.
about_security_text1: Investment Pool never stores users' funds.
about_security_text2: The platform has no access to private keys, seed phrases, or users' assets.
about_security_text3: All transactions are approved by the wallet owner and executed directly through the smart contract.
about_goal_text: To create a simple, transparent, and secure investment platform based on blockchain technology.
